visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with shoulder-length dark hair and a white t-shirt featuring a croissant graphic sits in a brightly lit room. Behind her is a white wall with a black-and-white floral and bird pattern. She talks to the camera, gesturing with her hands to introduce the topic. (2) The shot cuts to a closer view as she holds up one finger, then cuts to her holding two lip gloss products: one from YSL and one from Visee. (3) The camera focuses on the back of her hand where two gloss swatches are applied. She points to them, comparing their colors and textures. (4) The woman uses a heart-shaped mirror to apply the lip gloss. The screen is split with overlays indicating which product is being applied to each side of her lips. (5) She looks into the mirror, examining the results, and talks about the differences in oily texture and shine between the two brands. (6) A close-up of the Visee lip gloss packaging is shown to highlight the product details. (7) The woman smiles broadly and waves goodbye to the viewers, ending the segment in the same indoor setting.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A female creator with dark hair, wearing a white t-shirt with a croissant graphic and simple jewelry.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A white couch and a wall decorated with a dense floral and bird pattern wallpaper.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A lively female voice introduces the makeup comparison topic over bright, upbeat pop background music. The vocal tone is high in arousal and friendly. (2) As she shows the products, a subtle mechanical click is audible from the makeup packaging. The BGM maintains a steady, rhythmic pulse. (3) During the hand swatch demonstration, the speaker provides detailed, energetic narration. There's a short vocal interjection from an off-camera male voice asking a question, which she answers with increased pitch variability. (4) Soft application sounds are heard as she brushes the gloss on her lips. A small 'ding' sound effect emphasizes a key point about the texture. (5) The speaker concludes with an enthusiastic recommendation, her voice rising in pitch and volume to express excitement, followed by a final cheerful farewell.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Identification of Products -> Comparison/Swatch -> Testing/Application -> Verdict -> Recommendation
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To conduct a comparison between a luxury lip gloss and a more affordable drug-store version to see if the budget option can serve as a substitute.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator provides a direct call-to-action for the audience to purchase the Visee product after demonstrating its efficacy.

high_inference.freeDescribe: A standard beauty product comparison vlog characterized by high-energy narration and clear visual evidence of product performance.
